about.title: About IF Builder
about.p1: Create branches, objects, and define the interactions that advance your interactive fiction.
about.p2: All interactive fictions created here are exported in a .zip file. It doesn't need internet or the editor to work - just a browser. Think of this file like a USB flash drive: you can keep it in a drawer, or give it to someone.

about.title: About IF Builder
about.subtitle: Learn the mission and values behind IF Builder.

project.p1: IF Builder is an editor I developed to create interactive fiction - textual narratives where the player decides what happens next.
project.p2: Here, interactive fictions are written in branches. It's easy to visualize where each choice takes the player and how paths cross. If you want something to happen only if the player has a specific item or made a previous choice, the editor easily handles that.
project.p3: When finished, the editor exports a .zip file that works in any browser. Your story leaves the editor and goes straight to whoever wants to play. And if that person uses IF Builder, they can import the .zip file into the editor and see how you created your story. Maybe even make a remix?

versions.devlogContent:
🚀 Atualizações e Melhorias da Versão v0.9.1

• Otimização do Instalador Windows (NSIS): Adicionado seletor inicial de idioma (Português, Inglês e Espanhol), ícones personalizados do IF Builder para o instalador/desinstalador e banner de cabeçalho personalizado.
• Correção de Links no App Desktop: Solucionado o problema de clique nos links da tela "Sobre o Projeto" (incluindo o botão para www.ifbuildr.com, Substack e Ko-fi), que agora abrem diretamente no navegador padrão do sistema.
• Automação Completa de Releases: Sincronização automática do arquivo `latest.json`, notas de versão e modal de DevLog em um único commit, com publicação automática do Release Note formatado no GitHub Releases.
• Remoção do Auto-Updater Legado: Remoção completa de dependências e código legado de auto-update (@tauri-apps/plugin-updater), deixando o aplicativo mais leve e limpo.
versions.newsItem1: Automatic desktop update system with support for GitHub repositories.
versions.newsItem2: Notification with release notes summary and explicit confirmation to authorize download and installation.
versions.newsItem3: Direct download of Windows and Linux installers through the web version.
versions.uiItem1: Version number displayed aligned on the initial screen and boot screen.
versions.uiItem2: Integration of the download box and development log into the About Project tab.
versions.infraItem1: Support for private repositories via Vercel Serverless Function (/api/update and /api/download).
versions.infraItem2: Automatic version number synchronization in release scripts.

welcome.title: Welcome to IF Builder
welcome.subtitle: What do you want to do?
welcome.helpTItle: How to use the downloaded example
welcome.helpPlayDesc: Extract the contents of file.zip and open the index.html file to access the interactive fiction offline.
welcome.helpEditDesc: Click the LOAD button on the left side of the header to access and edit the project in IF Builder.
welcome.description: This is a tool for authors to create interactive fictions without hassle. Create branching narratives, control possible actions, and compile entire stories into a file.
welcome.bullet1Desc: Track the structure of your project graphically through the branch map.
welcome.bullet2Desc: Add numerical trackers like health, energy, or sanity to shape the consequences of choices.
welcome.bullet3Desc: Offer your players traditional action buttons or the freedom of a text interpreter (parser).
welcome.bullet4Desc: Generate .zip files independent of internet or servers. Just extract and play directly in the browser.

guide.title: Quick Guide
guide.intro: IF Builder allows you to create interactive fictions, text-based narratives where the player interacts with the story through choices or verbs. The fiction is composed of Branches, where the user reads descriptions, observes images, and makes decisions to interact with objects and navigate the world.

scenes.title: 1. Branch Editor
scenes.desc: Each branch is a location or moment in your game.
scenes.item1: Name and Description: Set the title and text the player will see when entering the branch.
scenes.item2: Interactive Text: Use < > around a word to make it clickable (e.g. <door>).
scenes.item3: Image and Music: Each branch can have its own background image and soundtrack.
scenes.item4: Home Branch: Define which branch will be the starting point in the sidebar.
scenes.item5: Ending Branch: Mark a branch as final to end the narrative.

objects.title: 2. Object Library
objects.desc: Objects are global and can be reused across multiple branches.
objects.item2: Examine: Detailed description the player sees when using "examine" or "look".
objects.item3: Image: Add an optional image to represent the object.
objects.item4: Collectible: Mark if the object can be added to the inventory.

interactions.title: 3. Interactions (The heart of the game)
interactions.desc: Defines what happens when the player types a verb.
interactions.item1: Verbs: Words that trigger the action (e.g. open, use, take).
interactions.item4: Result: Go to branch, change text, or play chapter.
interactions.tip: The system understands various orders (e.g. "Use key on door").

globals.title: 4. Global Verbs
globals.desc: Verbs that work in any branch of the game.
globals.item2: Description: Standard response for each global verb.

vignettes.title: 5. Chapters
vignettes.desc: Cinematic screens that enrich the narrative.
vignettes.item1: Opening: Displayed before the game starts (title screen).
vignettes.item2: Transition: Played during interactions for dramatic moments.
vignettes.item3: Conclusion: Shown at the end of the game (victory/defeat).
vignettes.tip: Customize image, music, text alignment, and animations.

trackers.title: 6. Consequence Trackers
trackers.item1: Initial and Max Value: Defines the scale (e.g. 0/100).
trackers.item2: Consequence Branch: Where the player goes when reaching the limit.
trackers.item3: Customization: Choose color, icon, and bar mode (normal or inverted).

map.title: 7. Connections Map
map.desc: Visualize the structure of your game graphically.
map.item1: Bird's Eye View: See all branches and how they connect.
map.item2: Quick Navigation: Click on a branch on the map to edit it.
map.item3: Positioning: Drag branches to organize the visual layout.

preview.title: 9. Preview and Test
preview.item1: Use the Preview button to test the whole experience.
preview.item2: Test from any branch you are editing.
preview.item3: Check if verbs and interactions work as expected.

export.title: 10. Saving and Loading Projects
export.warning: IMPORTANT: Remember to ALWAYS save your project, as the editor does not record any sessions. If you leave without saving, just like in older programs, you will lose ALL your progress!
export.desc: When your game is ready (or to save your progress):
export.item1: Fully test all branches and endings using the Preview Mode.
export.item2: Click the Save button (floppy disk icon) in the top menu.
export.item3: Give your project a name. The editor will download a unified .zip file.
export.item5: To continue editing: Use the Load button uploading this same .zip file.

manualModal.title: User Manual
manualModal.subtitle: Learn how to create your interactive adventure
manualModal.intro: The IF Builder allows you to create Interactive Fiction games. The game is composed of Branches, where the player reads descriptions, looks at images, and types verbs to interact with Objects and navigate the world.
manualModal.section1Intro: Each branch is a location or moment in your game. Configure:
manualModal.section1Item1: Interactive Text: Use the <word> syntax in the description. This will make the word clickable in the game.
manualModal.section1Item2: Image and Music: Each branch can have a unique background image and soundtrack.
manualModal.section1Item3: Start Branch: Set which branch will be the starting point.
manualModal.section2Intro: Objects are items that can be in a branch. They are global: you create an object once and can link it to multiple branches.
manualModal.section2Item1: Examine: Define a detailed description that the player will see.
manualModal.section3Intro: Interactions define what happens when the player types a verb.
manualModal.verbsDesc: List of words that trigger the action (e.g., open, unlock, use).
manualModal.targetDesc: The object in the branch the player wants to interact with (e.g., Door).
manualModal.reqDesc: The item the player MUST have in their inventory (e.g., Key).
manualModal.resDesc: What happens after the verb (e.g., go to another branch).
manualModal.tip: 💡 Tip: The player can type in any order. The system will automatically identify the keywords.
manualModal.section4Intro: Use trackers to create complex systems like Health, Money, or Stress.
manualModal.section4Item1: Interactions can increase or decrease a tracker's value.
manualModal.section4Item2: When a tracker reaches its maximum value, the player is automatically transported to a Branch of Consequence.
manualModal.section5Item1: Use the Preview button to test the entire experience.
manualModal.section5Item2: Click Export Game to download a .zip file.
manualModal.section5Item3: Extract the zip and open the index.html file in any browser to play or share!
